_comment: Placeholder for an exported n8n workflow. In n8n: duplicate your EchoDebug pipeline, then Export → Download, and replace this file. Import it on your own n8n Cloud (or self-hosted) instance, activate it, and copy the production webhook URL. Configure that URL with ECHODEBUG_WEBHOOK_URL, ~/.echodebugrc, --webhook, or `echorun --setup`. Expected POST JSON: { "command", "error_log", "framework" }. Expected response JSON: { "root_cause_summary", "terminal_fix_command", "audio_url" } (audio_url may be a data:audio/mpeg;base64 URL or an http(s) link).
name: EchoDebug
